item.title: LWIG E001
item.description:
This is the first post in this series. I have no idea if its the last. It could be. My past experience doing such kinds of challenges says it possibly is. But, who am I to pull the plug on what could be.

Had the same sentinment for lwic and 8 weeks later, it still stands.

May the force be with it.

So in this series of posts, a weekly series, I will be sharing updates on progress getting better in a variety of life domains. Could be social, spiritual, related to career, intellect, any problem I have no issue making a public record of.
